title: Railway testimonials
description: A framed, faintly plum panel of social proof: a centred book-serif heading, a grey lead and an outline button; three double-bordered customer cards with a wordmark, a long quote and a portrait, each with a faint grid fading into its lower corner; then a sans heading and an endless, slowly sliding row of short social posts with pink mentions.
notes: logos and avatars are slots; empty avatars show muted circles
the post row loops left in 120s (CSS only) and stops with reduced motion
best on dark themes: the plum wash is a highlight tint over the page background
